title: dedicated-capacity-weekly-prep-notes
content:
Meeting: Dedicated Capacity planning weekly prep (weekly sync + 1:1 prep)
Owner: Alex Kim (notes / prep scratchpad)
Date of sync: 2026-03-04 (weekly sync) / 2026-03-05 (follow-up 1:1 with Priya)
Attendees (expected): Priya, Miguel, Taylor, SRE rep, Sales rep (if time)

Goal:
- Align on GPU pool forecast for next quarter, confirm reservation targets, and finalize autoscaling policy tweaks for burst windows.
- Surface capacity risks for top 5 customers and proposed mitigations.

Quick numbers snapshot (last 7 days):
- Avg GPU utilization (prod pools): 72%
- Peak observed: 96% (2026-03-01 15:10 UTC, causal: demo event + large embedding job)
- Spot/elastic capacity used: 18% of total during peaks
- Reserved capacity utilization rate: 84% (seems healthy but tight on p100/p40 pool)

Forecast inputs / assumptions:
- Sales pipeline: 3 large deals (expected onboarding Q2) -> add 4-6k GPU hours/week between them (DEDI-342 notes)
- New feature rollout (batch embeddings autopruning): expected to increase sustained throughput +15% starting 2026-04-10
- Model mix shift: small increase in quantized Llama-3 variants (reduces per-token cost but still similar peak GPU seconds)

Proposed reservation plan (Q2):
- Keep core reserved pool at current level for latency SLO customers (no change).
- Increase pooled reservation for balanced workloads by +20% (target add: 8 V100-equivalent GPUs) to cover projected steady growth.
- Add a temporary burst reserve (monthly) of 6 GPUs to be used during predictable events (demos, marketing spikes).
- Consider converting 10% of burst/spot budget to short-term reserved contracts for largest customer if they commit (sales to confirm).

Autoscaling policy tweaks (proposal):
- Current: scale-out threshold at 75% avg across pool for 5m, scale-in at 40% for 10m. Max scale-out steps: 4 nodes.
- Proposal: move scale-out threshold to 70% for 3m to be more proactive; allow 6-node max scale-out during peak hours (12:00-20:00 UTC) for next 6 weeks as experiment.
- Add health-check weighting: prioritize low-latency routes when deciding which jobs to preempt during scale-out.
- Add cooldown if scale-out triggered by single large batch job (>2k concurrent requests) to avoid oscillation.

Risk log / open concerns:
- Risk: sustained peaks may eat into spot/elastic buffer faster than predicted -> mitigation: pre-alloc burst + temporary reserved buys.
- Risk: sudden onboarding of a large enterprise (unknown job profiles) could cause cold-start KV cache misses and latency regressions. Action: require early perf capture (staging) from sales handoff.
- Concern: budget impact of longer reserved increases vs. unit-cost savings unclear; finance needs a quick calc.

Agenda (sync):
1) Quick numbers (2m) - Alex
2) Forecast assumptions & sales updates (5m) - Priya
3) Reservation proposal & approval ask (5m) - Miguel
4) Autoscaling experiment plan (5m) - Taylor
5) Top customer risks / mitigations (5m) - SRE rep
6) Actions / owners / deadlines (3m)

Questions to raise in the meeting:
- Priya: can you confirm which of the three deals have LOIs and expected prod start date? (quick yes/no for commit sizing)
- Sales: any of the customers require private deployments or special isolation that would change capacity planning?
- SRE: do we have playbooks for pre-emptive KV cache warming when adding reserved nodes?
- Finance: do we have a quick ROI calc for converting burst budget to 6-month reserved contract?

Action items (pre-meeting prep):
- Alex: pull last 30 days of pool-level histograms (p99 latency, avg utilization) and add to Confluence page (due 2026-03-03) -> DONE (uploaded)
- Priya: confirm LOI statuses for the 3 pipeline deals and send expected weekly GPU hours (due 2026-03-03) -> pending (send before sync)
- Miguel: prepare reservation cost delta (monthly) for +8 GPUs vs. burst-on-demand (due 2026-03-03) -> in progress (link in PR)
- Taylor: draft autoscaling experiment runbook and rollback criteria (due 2026-03-04) -> working draft attached to PR

Post-meeting follow-ups (1:1 with Priya):
- Ask for customer-level expected job profiles (embedding vs. chat vs. batch) so we can map to pool types.
- Get commitment timeline for any customers that would prefer Dedicated private.

Notes / scratch ideas:
- Could temporarily rebalance low-util reserved GPUs to a pooled burst group for weekends (less latency-sensitive jobs) to free up on-weekday headroom. Need approval from product owners.
- Try a lab experiment: simulate onboarding of 1 large customer profile for 48 hours to observe KV cold-start impact and autoscaler behavior. Use canary pool.
- Track cost per effective GPU-hour post-quantization changes to update forecast (DEDI-342 to capture).

References / links to add to final Confluence:
- Confluence: Capacity Forecast (https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DED/Capacity+Forecast)
- Jira: DEDI-342 (sales pipeline + capacity ask)
- GitHub PR: dedicated-config/pull/78 (autoscaling policy prototype)

Meeting notes (to capture during sync):
- Confirmed: Priya -> two deals have verbal LOI, one needs legal review. Expected combined add: ~4k GPU hours/week, timeline mid-April.
- Miguel: reservation delta looks like +$12k/month for 8 GPUs vs. burst; finance needs to sign off; estimated break-even 3.1 months given projected utilization.
- SRE: agreed to autoscaler experiment; will add additional observability hooks (node lifecycle events + preempt logs).
- Action owner assignments: Miguel finalize reservation purchase approval paperwork (due 2026-03-10), Priya send signed LOI copies (due 2026-03-12), Taylor run autoscaler experiment week of 2026-03-15 and report.

Follow-up TODO (my list):
- Update Confluence forecast table with new inputs from Priya and Miguel (due 2026-03-05).
- Open ticket for simulation experiment (DEDI-387?) and assign to SRE + Taylor.
- Schedule 30m post-experiment review to decide whether to convert burst to reserved.

Quick personal notes:
- Bring up potential short-term customer credits if we ask them to shift onboarding window (sales negotiation tactic).
- Remind legal to prioritize the LOI review for the largest deal; delays will push reservation purchase timing.

Scratch:  
- If we get the +8 GPUs reserved, move 2 GPUs from the p100 pool to pooled-burst to cover immediate demo needs for next 6 weeks.
- Consider tagging large-customer jobs so autoscaler can treat them differently (no preemption) - needs infra support.

---
End of prep notes.
